subject.title: feat(plugin-sdk): let plugins open Gateway-managed realtime voice sessions

question: Should OpenClaw publish `runtime.talk.openSession` as a supported Plugin SDK contract that allows trusted Gateway-dispatch plugins to select an agent session and receive its raw realtime audio?
rationale: This is a new public, compatibility-sensitive SDK surface with intentional trusted-plugin access to agent-session voice output; code review alone cannot select the permanent product and permission boundary.

options.title: Sponsor the trusted session API
options.body: Approve the explicit trusted-plugin contract, then merge the prerequisite and refresh this PR against main with the documented lifecycle and compatibility tests.

options.title: Narrow the capability
options.body: Retain the feature direction but redesign it around a smaller permission or output surface before publishing a Plugin SDK method.

options.title: Keep this outside the SDK
options.body: Do not add the core Plugin SDK contract until a maintainer-approved extension boundary exists.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the trusted session API
recommendation.body: Approve the explicit trusted-plugin contract, then merge the prerequisite and refresh this PR against main with the documented lifecycle and compatibility tests.

likelyOwner.reason: RomneyDa is the active contributor across the linked Talk/Plugin SDK stack and can supply implementation context; final acceptance remains a maintainer product decision.
